outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of Diaspot and HBV-5 rapid diagnostic tests
cohort: 83 children living with HIV (CLHIV) aged 15 years or younger at the Essos Hospital Centre, Yaounde, Cameroon
finding: The prevalence of HBV infection in CLHIV in Cameroon appears to be moderate, suggesting a decreased burden likely due to preventive measures, including widespread vaccination.
